content: The fragrance of sandalwood spreads only with the wind, but the fragrance of a righteous life spreads in all directions.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Na pupphagandho pativatameti — Dhammapada & Subhashita Lore
explanation: Physical aromatics—jasmine, cedar, and rose—are bound by aerodynamics; their perfume can only travel where the breeze carries them. But a life lived with unwavering kindness, courage, and truth transcends physical barriers, perfuming the hearts of generations yet unborn.
practicalInsight: Perform an act of quiet virtue in secret today. Trust that goodness possesses its own divine, omnidirectional fragrance.
reflectionPrompt: What kind of invisible fragrance is your daily demeanor leaving in the rooms and lives you pass through?
